message.content: On September 20th, 2026, at 12:00 PM, Thane Chambers asks Li Hua about her favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, Thane inquires, "What’s your favorite first-person shooter game? I’m curious!" Li Hua responds by mentioning that she is really into "Call of Duty: Warzone," appreciating the battle royale mode and the strategy involved in the game. She also shares that she loves the adrenaline rush during the final circle. Thane then asks Li Hua about her favorite aspects of "Warzone" and whether she has experienced any memorable victories in the game. Li Hua shares that she had a memorable match where they managed to outsmart the last team, which was a great team effort. Thane expresses interest in the upcoming updates for "Warzone" and asks if Li Hua plans to dive back into the game when the updates roll out. Li Hua enthusiastically agrees and mentions that she loves exploring new content and teaming up with friends, looking forward to playing together when the updates come out.
